Self-hosted copies of third-party files, so the app makes no requests to other sites (a CDN script could read your keys).

| File | From | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | `marked/lib/marked.umd.js` | 18.1.0 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | `dompurify/dist/purify.min.js` | 3.4.16 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `tabler-icons.min.css`, `fonts/tabler-icons.woff2` | `@tabler/icons-webfont` (woff2 only) | 3.49.0 | MIT |
| `fonts.css`, `fonts/{inter,outfit,ibm-plex-mono}-*.woff2` | `@fontsource/*` (latin subset) | 5.3.0 | OFL-1.1 |

To update: `npm i` the package in a scratch folder and copy the file over.
